plugins.description: Authoritative, version-pinned offline reference for Expo SDK 56 (RN 0.85) and SDK 57 (RN 0.86) — for building on either release and for the 55→56 and 56→57 migrations. Bundles 21 API reference docs; each carries an SDK 57 delta section. Audited against expo/expo source 2026-07-25; treat as point-in-time.
